description: Returns the authenticated user's monitoring events: material reputation changes detected on their monitored addresses, oldest first, each with the change type, a summary, and the band transition. Also returns a deterministic digest that rolls up the window into one sentence. Page forward by passing the returned nextCursor as cursor. Bound the window with since and until, or restrict to one address with address. Costs zero credits.

address.description: Restrict to one monitored address (0x...). Omit for the whole portfolio.

cursor.description: Pass the nextCursor from a prior call to page forward.

since.description: ISO-8601 lower bound. Only events at or after this time are returned.

until.description: ISO-8601 upper bound. Only events at or before this time are returned.

name: get_monitoring_events

digest.description: Deterministic rollup of the events in this window

events.description: Monitoring events in the window, oldest first

id.description: Event id. Pass it as cursor to page past this event.

minor.description: True for a trivial change safe to de-emphasise

triggerType.description: Primary change type: floor_added, band_downgrade, band_upgrade, or score_delta

hasMore.description: True when more events remain past this page

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when none remain

title: Get monitoring events
